name: 江湖风云3
english_description: In-game titled "Sunset Reappears: Storm Rising II," a Jin Yong-themed wuxia mudlib built on jhfy2's map (7,977 of jhfy2's 9,332 files overlap by path) but running it on a different core-system lineage. New characters can approach a cloned Linghu Chong (`bai huchong`) at Huashan to become a "fifteenth-generation disciple," buy Hami melons from a Xinjiang-frontier peddler and resell them to a Persian merchant at Gaochang, and send working in-game mail through the post office. This archive's own "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is word-for-word identical not to jhfy2's "Tianya"-family version but to xajh4gkb (Xiao'ao Jianghu 4, Public Edition) and byte-identical to xyzx (one of the original "Sunset Reappears" releases) — confirming "Sunset Reappears" is a separate code lineage from "Tianya," stitched here onto jhfy2's map. Registration uses a double-password scheme (separate admin/login passwords) unlike jhfy2's single password.
